items.requirement: An authorized opaque principal can look up an existing soft-hold by id and receive its hold details. When the hold does not exist or is not visible, lookup fails with a named domain error and does not mutate stock or holds.
items.rationale: Lookup correctness and a stable missing/not-visible failure vocabulary are the core delta; callers and contract tests need machine-checkable success and failure semantics.
items.threshold: Authorized lookup of an existing visible soft-hold returns that hold; missing or not-visible hold always fails with the named domain error and never mutates stock or holds.
items.measurement: OCL-derived Vitest contract tests plus OpenAPI error-channel exercises for named missing/not-visible lookup failures and successful get-by-id.

items.requirement: Only an authorized opaque principal may look up a soft-hold by id. Unauthorized callers fail with a named domain error; stock and holds are unchanged.
items.rationale: Extends the user-settled opaque-principal authZ pattern from initial-reservation to the additive read API; still not a full IAM product.
items.threshold: Unauthorized lookup always fails with the named unauthorized domain error and never mutates stock or holds; authorized opaque principal can look up when the hold is visible.
items.measurement: Contract tests and OpenAPI authZ failure channel; OCL preconditions on lookup.

items.requirement: N/A — no latency or throughput targets for this evaluation sample.
items.rationale: Additive read API on the same sample workload; no SLI asked.

items.requirement: Lookup behavior is checkable via HTTP/API (OpenAPI) and module DbC (UML OCL) with Vitest contract tests; do not rely on opaque internals alone.
items.rationale: solid_sdd evaluation path requires machine-checkable surfaces for the delta as for prior reserve/release/expire.
items.threshold: openapi/openapi.yaml documents lookup; contracts/**/*.ocl and tests/contracts/** cover get-by-id success and named missing/unauthorized failures and pass.
items.measurement: Presence of OpenAPI + OCL + passing Vitest under tests/contracts/** for lookup.

items.requirement: Additive OpenAPI change at openapi/openapi.yaml: add lookup without breaking existing reserve/release/expire client surface from initial-reservation.
items.rationale: Follow-on change; prior HTTP surface must remain; lookup is additive.
items.threshold: openapi/openapi.yaml remains structurally valid; existing reserve/release operations stay documented; lookup is added without removing prior operations.
items.measurement: solidsdd-verify OpenAPI lint check (or skipped with tooling reason); review that prior paths remain.

items.requirement: UML OCL under contracts/**/*.ocl remains the DbC source of truth; Vitest under tests/contracts/** covers lookup behaviors derived from OCL.
items.rationale: Matches solid_sdd adapter policy and inherited contract/test layout from the repo.
items.threshold: contracts/**/*.ocl include lookup pre/post or equivalent invariants; derived Vitest tests exercise get-by-id success and named failures.
items.measurement: Inspect contracts/ and tests/contracts/; regenerate via solidsdd-derive-tests when OCL changes.
